thm:main.statement: There exists a fixed finite bounded self-adjoint tuple with -infinity<chi<=chiStar-1/2<infinity.
thm:main.conditions: Faithful normal tracial von Neumann algebra;original operator-norm cutoff chi with limsup;existential n>=2,not every prescribed n.
thm:main.constants_and_limits: Proof chooses p=2^64,n=p+1,t=2^48,then sufficiently small h>0;all fixed BEFORE matrix limits. No small-dimensional/effective numerical counterexample or engineering performance claim.

lem:variational.statement: Free Fisher information is the supremum of a quadratic polynomial-test functional;countably many rational-complex symmetrized tests suffice.
lem:variational.conditions: Bounded self-adjoint tuple with existing conjugate variables;self-adjoint noncommuting test polynomials.
lem:variational.constants_and_limits: Continuous moments yield measurable Fisher information;no conclusion that classical entropy converges or that finite tests attain the supremum.

lem:matrix-convergence.statement: Uniformly converging bounded matrix models with independent GUE give free joint polynomial traces in probability and finite-product expectation convergence.
lem:matrix-convergence.conditions: Common coordinate operator-norm bound;uniform normalized joint trace moments over K_d;noise independent of entire input;fixed finite number of coordinates.
lem:matrix-convergence.constants_and_limits: Any diverging dimension sequence. GUE norm tail and Gaussian Poincare control moments/variance;no finite explicit moment-convergence sample budget.

lem:wick.statement: Free Gaussian perturbation admits orthonormal Wick tests and conjugate variables u^-1/2 E[S_i|W*(Z)].
lem:wick.conditions: Centered bounded self-adjoint C;standard semicircular S free from C;u>0;ordered-index polynomial derivatives.
lem:wick.constants_and_limits: Expansion deletes disjoint originally adjacent equal-index pairs;do not recursively delete newly adjacent pairs. Bilinear trace identity requires reversed adjoint words.

prop:fisher.statement: Fisher deficit above matched coordinate semicircular variances is bounded by squared ell2 norms of all higher free-cumulant arrays.
prop:fisher.conditions: Centered bounded C with diagonal covariance c_i>=0;free standard S;u>0. Upper series bound requires sum_(r>=2)u^-r||kappa_(r+1)||2^2 finite.
prop:fisher.constants_and_limits: Always sum_i1/(u+c_i)<=PhiStar<=n/u;deficit<=u^-2 times stated series. Finite empirical cumulants alone do not certify its infinite tail;not classical cumulants.

lem:cumulants.statement: The tensor-independent common-label signal has ||kappa_m(C)||2<=128^m*p^(m/4) for all m>=1.
lem:cumulants.conditions: C=(B1,...,Bp,Y),free variance-one semicircular B_i;Y uniform p atoms in[-1,1],tensor independent/commuting with every B_i;not freely independent of B_i.
lem:cumulants.constants_and_limits: Entry bounds32^m and sparse support at most(1+4sqrt(p))^m. For u>2*128^2*sqrt(p),Fisher deficit<=2*128^6*p^1.5*u^-4;not a generic data-driven tail bound.

lem:finitechi.statement: For the chosen noisy signal X=V_h,microstates entropy is greater than -infinity.
lem:finitechi.conditions: Fixed h>0;deterministic block matrix models at dimensions d=pq,uniform cutoff,independent variance-h GUE smoothing.
lem:finitechi.constants_and_limits: Gaussian density bound gives chi>=n/2 log(2pi h) along a subsequence. Limsup permits this;no liminf/all-dimensions entropy assertion.

lem:flow.statement: A selected sequence of cutoff-uniform microstate ensembles has terminal entropy limsup at least chi_R(X)+half the free Fisher integral.
lem:flow.conditions: Fixed R with chi_R>-infinity;positive-volume increasingly accurate microstate sets at same R;independent standard GUE. Keep selected dimension sequence and SAME terminal laws.
lem:flow.constants_and_limits: Unnormalized Hilbert-Schmidt real coordinates:H_d=hclass/d^2+n/2 log d,I_d=d^-3 integral||grad log f||^2. Polynomial score tests,Fatou and deBruijn;terminal limsup is not replaced by chi of limiting law.

lem:eventprob.statement: A simultaneous block-energy event has probability at least1/2 for the selected terminal ensembles but at most exp(-4d^2) under variance-matched independent GUE.
lem:eventprob.conditions: p=2^64,t=2^48 fixed;h chosen small by spectral gaps;all sufficiently large d. Spectral projections are selected from initial A_n before adding independent noise.
lem:eventprob.constants_and_limits: Ranks<=2d/p,first-p normalized norm cutoff4sqrt(vp),compressed energy thresholdsqrt(p)/4. Markov noise energy<=2t;unitary net and(d+1)^p rank lists. Binary KL deficit plus SAME-terminal entropy bridge yields gap;no explicit full convergence threshold.

JP.scope: Conditional classical-to-free Fisher comparison and entropy inequality with stated moment/tail hypotheses. Uses normalized-trace matrix metric,I_scaled=N^-4 I_class;F298 uses unnormalized HS,I_scaled=d^-3 I_class. Coordinate change,not a disagreement or interchangeable literal factor.

Jconv.scope: Equality of entropy notions for convex-potential ensembles with uniform upper curvature,concentration,tail and trace-polynomial gradient approximation hypotheses. Uniform strict convexity is a sufficient extra route in Remark7.2,not necessary wording of Theorem7.1. All hypotheses are not established for F298.

Dab.scope: Equality for the law solving Schwinger-Dyson equation for a potential in the specific E_app^(1,1) class. This is a restricted convex-functional result;does not assert equality for every finite-entropy tuple. Complete proof/class closure not audited.

Gsurvey.scope: Historical conjecture asks equality when chi is finite from below. Gaussian-relative normalization in preceding discussion must be translated before comparing raw entropy values. A conjecture,not an equality theorem.

Vsurvey.scope: Author survey defines nonmicrostates entropy through the free-noise Fisher integral and discusses the unification question. Selected definition/history checked;not an audit of the original II/V proofs or all survey claims.

Szarek.scope: Elementary volume-ratio covering/packing bounds in finite-dimensional normed spaces. Supports unitary ambient-net technique;it is an older tool,not a free-entropy separation or computational advantage.

NS.scope: Noncrossing moment/cumulant inversion;semicircular higher cumulants vanish;independent Gaussian and convergent deterministic matrices are asymptotically free. Selected statements only;other cited combinatorial bounds and book proofs are not fully audited.
